_metadata.description: Generalizable defect construction principles for any crystal structure
_metadata.purpose: Enable LLM to construct defects in unseen materials using structure-type rules

_usage_guide.principle: Explicit task geometry, cell and charge constraints override examples.
workflow: Verify the parent lattice, complete basis and cell convention.
Preserve the pristine reference; apply the requested supercell and site edits.
Check operation-derived composition and periodic geometry; do not invent compensating defects.

supercell_rules.principle: Explicit task cell, concentration and geometry take precedence. Primitive and conventional cells are both valid when their lattice and complete basis are consistent.
supercell_rules.reason: Parent basis, lattice and multiplicity must use the same cell convention.

atom_count_formulas.general: N_supercell = N_parent * abs(det(M)); L_supercell = M @ L_parent for integer nonsingular M and row lattice vectors.
atom_count_formulas.site_edits: n_final[e] = n_initial[e] - n_removed[e] + n_added[e]. A substitution removes one host species and adds one dopant; it does not change total site count.
atom_count_formulas.coordinates: f_supercell = (f_parent + integer_parent_image) @ inv(M); division by repeat factors applies only to diagonal M.

expected_atoms_examples.condition: Illustrations only: use the verified parent count and requested transformation, not a material-name constant.
expected_atoms_examples.eight_site_parent: An 8-site parent with diag(3,3,3) gives 216 sites before edits.
expected_atoms_examples.two_site_parent: A 2-site primitive parent with the same repetition gives 54 sites; these are different simulation cells.

pymatgen_code.note: Preserve the pristine parent and supercell for independent site mapping; batch removal indices refer to the unedited structure.

supercell_rules.size_selection: If unspecified, size the cell by concentration and periodic image separation; establish isolation by convergence, not a fixed repetition count.

steps: 1. Build the requested supercell from a verified parent and retain an unedited reference
2. Identify target site by species and/or position
3. Remove site using structure.remove_sites([index])
4. Verify remaining atom count = original - 1

site_selection.specific: Match fractional coordinates to target position
site_selection.by_distance: Match the requested environment with periodic neighbors; being far from a cell edge is not a physical distinction in a periodic bulk.

charge_considerations.ionic_compounds: May need compensating defect for charge neutrality
charge_considerations.semiconductors: Creates localized states in band gap

substitution_construction.principle: Replace host atom with dopant atom at same site
steps: 1. Create supercell
2. Find index of atom to replace
3. Use structure.replace(index, 'Dopant') or structure[index] = 'Dopant'
4. Verify composition changed correctly

site_preference_rules.size_matching: Dopant prefers sites of similar ionic radius
site_preference_rules.valence_matching: Dopant prefers sites of similar oxidation state

dopant_separation.dilute_limit: Use the specified separation or concentration and periodic image distances; no universal distance guarantees noninteracting dopants.
dopant_separation.clustering: If dopants cluster, use specific pair positions

interstitial_construction.principle: Add extra atom at non-lattice position
steps: 1. Build the requested supercell from a verified parent
2. Identify interstitial site from structure type template
3. Map the parent fractional position and chosen parent-cell image through the inverse integer supercell matrix
4. Add atom using structure.append('Species', coords)
5. Check the requested coordination and element-pair separations using periodic neighbors

site_types_by_structure.condition: Template coordinates require the same parent basis and cell setting; confirm the unoccupied site and periodic coordination.

coordinate_conversion.rule: For row lattice vectors L_super = M @ L_parent, use f_super = (f_parent + image) @ inv(M).

dumbbell_interstitial.principle: Split interstitial - two atoms share one lattice site
dumbbell_interstitial.description: Replace one lattice atom with two atoms displaced along crystallographic direction
steps: 1. Build the requested supercell and retain the target site in the pristine reference
2. Get Cartesian coordinates of target lattice site
3. Remove atom at target site
4. Choose separation from the explicit task or a material- and orientation-specific starting estimate
5. Add two atoms at: center ± (separation/2) × normalized_direction
6. Use coords_are_cartesian=True for precise placement
7. Verify periodic contacts and the requested dumbbell geometry; recheck after any relaxation

common_orientations.condition: Examples, not universal stability rankings; explicit task orientation takes precedence.

displacement_formula.dumbbell_separation: A fraction of the actual local nearest-neighbor distance can initialize a model; it is not a universal equilibrium distance or acceptance threshold.
displacement_formula.critical_constraint: Use task geometry and chemically appropriate element-pair constraints; a validation cutoff does not define a physical dumbbell.

antisite_construction.principle: Atom on wrong sublattice in compound
steps: 1. Create supercell
2. Find atom of species A on sublattice A
3. Find atom of species B on sublattice B
4. Swap their species: A→B and B→A
5. Verify composition unchanged but arrangement different

types.single_antisite: One atom on wrong site (creates charge imbalance in ionic)

schottky_defect.principle: Paired cation and anion vacancies for charge neutrality
steps: 1. Create supercell
2. Find nearest-neighbor cation-anion pair
3. Remove both atoms
4. Verify charge balance maintained

stoichiometry_rules.perovskite_ABX3: Remove 1 A + 1 B + 3 X (rare, usually just oxygen vacancies)

steps: 1. Create supercell
2. Remove atom from lattice site (create vacancy)
3. Add same species at interstitial site
4. Net composition unchanged

fluorite_anion_frenkel.description: F/O vacancy + F/O at octahedral interstitial

NV_center.description: One N substitution plus one distinct neighboring vacancy in the C host.
NV_center.construction_reference: L2_structures.defect.complex_defects.defect_complexes.NV_center; resolve periodic neighbors from the verified parent, not fixed supercell coordinates.

E_center.description: One P substitution plus one distinct neighboring vacancy in the Si host.
E_center.construction_reference: L2_structures.defect.complex_defects.defect_complexes.E_center; resolve periodic neighbors from the verified parent, not fixed supercell coordinates.

divacancy.description: Two vacancies with a specified relative geometry

orientations.selection: Map the requested crystal direction and separation to the appropriate parent neighbor shell; do not assume every direction is nearest-neighbor.

construction: 2. Select two original sites satisfying the requested periodic direction and separation

minimum_interatomic.principle: Use task-specified or chemically justified element-pair distances, including bonded versus nonbonded context; knowledge does not prescribe a universal pass threshold.
minimum_interatomic.measurement: Use periodic minimum-image distances and include self images when assessing a small cell or defect-image separation.

defect_separation.principle: Explicit concentration, separation and supercell constraints take precedence. Isolation is established by measured periodic geometry and property convergence, not a fixed 3x3x3 or 10 Angstrom rule.

charge_balance_rules.principle: Track the requested charge state and operation-derived stoichiometry. Do not add or remove atoms solely to force a nominal oxidation-state sum to zero when electronic compensation or a charged defect was requested.

Fe_doped_SrTiO3.substitution: Fe³⁺ replaces Sr²⁺ (1+ charge) or Ti⁴⁺ (1- charge)

pymatgen_api_patterns.operations: Use make_supercell, remove_sites, replace and append on a copy of the verified parent. Batch removal uses original indices; sequential removal must avoid index shifts.
